policyInventory.detail: Insider Risk policy inventory automation is not supported on a first-party documented GA surface. Use only first-party documented GA surfaces. Collect policy inventory through manual portal export.
manualEvidenceRequired: Purview portal export: Insider Risk Management > Policies (name, template, status, scope).
Purview portal export: Alerts reviewed/dispositioned for the current quarter.
Reviewer attestation linking alert dispositions to case records.

auditDependency.detail: Unified Audit Log ingestion is disabled; Insider Risk evidence must be treated as incomplete until audit ingestion is restored.
